name: CMIP5 historical daily simulation archive (14 ESMs)
model_or_instrument: 14 CMIP5 Earth system models (BCC-CSM1.1, BNU-ESM, CanESM2, CNRM-CM5, CSIRO-Mk3.6, GFDL-CM3, GFDL-ESM2G, GFDL-ESM2M, MIROC5, MIROC-ESM, MIROC-ESM-CHEM, MRI-CGCM3, MRI-ESM1, NorESM1-M)
resolution: Daily temporal resolution; varying spatial resolutions from 128x64 to 320x160; 1950-01-01 to 2005-12-31

scales.note: 14 CMIP5 models spanning 1950-01-01 to 2005-12-31 (56 years) at daily resolution; resolutions range from 320x160 (~1.125 deg) to 128x64 (~2.8 deg).
